name: navbar-side-rail
title: Side rail navbar
description: A navigation rail fixed to the left edge: the mark at the top, large vertical links, contact and profiles at the foot, and a top bar with a menu sheet on a phone.
docs: Wrap your page: <NavbarSideRail brand links footer currentHref>{page}</NavbarSideRail>. From lg up the rail is fixed to the left edge and the page sits beside it, padded by the rail width (width, default 16rem), which is also written on the root as --rail-width for your own full-bleed or fixed parts. links take label, href and an optional count; currentHref marks the current page with aria-current and a dot. footer takes email, social ({ label, href }) and a note, and sits at the foot of the rail and of the phone menu. Below lg the rail is a sticky top bar with the brand and a Menu button that opens a sheet with the same links. The rail is position: fixed, so the window must scroll (inside a frame, give the frame a transform). The page region is a main landmark: mainId names it for a skip link, contentAs="div" drops the landmark. linkAs renders the links with your router Link.
